name: Google Vision API
description: Pre-trained ML models for image analysis. Wnode acts as a pre- and post-processing layer — preparing images for Vision API recognition and consuming structured results for downstream pipelines. Workloads invoked via this integration run on Wnode's Tier 6 DECC/TEE secure enclaves.
